description.en: The ID of the image that is being copied.

description.zh: 目标镜像所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the destination image. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

title.zh: 取消正在进行中的复制镜像任务
title.en: Cancel an ongoing image copy task

descriptions.zh:
调用该接口时，您需要注意：

- 取消复制镜像后，目标地域中新建的镜像会被自动删除，源镜像保持不变。
- 若复制镜像已完成，则操作失败并返回错误提示。
descriptions.en:
When you call this operation, take note of the following items:

- After you cancel the image copy task, the image that was being created in the destination region is automatically deleted. The source image remains unchanged.
- If the image copy task is already complete, the operation fails and an error message is returned.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs cancel-copy-image --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-id m-bp1caf3yicx5jlfl0000 --region cn-hangzhou
